kept.name: TestApplyStamp
kept.reason: pins that a stamp is replaced in place or prepended with the body hash unchanged, where the restamp test reaches only the replacing case

kept.name: TestBodyHash
kept.reason: pins that CRLF and a changed banner hash like their LF and old-banner twins while a changed body does not, which no covering test asserts

kept.name: TestClassify
kept.reason: pins the state each on-disk shape classifies to, which the reconcile tests observe only through the file outcome
